crossRefs.note: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,
Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

translations.web: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.
translations.bsb: For the Sadducees say that there is neither a resurrection nor angels nor spirits, but the Pharisees acknowledge them all.
translations.kjv: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
translations.asv: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess both.
